spec.hypothesis: conf>=2 标签过滤是否提升 probe 质量（quality vs quantity tradeoff）

experiment_data.hypothesis: Training on conf>=2 subset only (higher quality labels) produces better probe than training on all data (including noisy conf=1). Uses probe-002's split for fair comparison on the same 8101-window test set.

vs_probe_002_full_test.note: Training on conf>=2 only hurts full test performance by -5.9pp

vs_probe_001_conf2_test.note: On conf>=2 test subset (different split), conf2-subset improves +2.3pp

metrics.finding: Conf>=2 training improves performance on high-confidence test windows (+2.3pp vs probe_001) but degrades on full test distribution (-5.9pp vs probe-002). The noisy conf=1 training data helps the model generalize to conf=1 test windows. Removing 72% of training data (conf=1 windows) causes significant regression on the full distribution.
